name: SPACE RELICS
included: V1 archive, timeline, stories, quiz, comparison and student learning modules
V2 interactive 3D Moon/Mars globe with mission markers
V2 NASA-hosted Apollo Lunar Module 3D model and component engineering inspector
Local research notebook, bookmarks and JSON export
Ten-question interactive assessment and locally stored best score
PWA manifest and service worker for offline shell caching
storage: Browser localStorage only; no login, server database, cross-device sync or cloud backups.
external_dependencies: NASA hosted Apollo Lunar Module GLB
NASA Image and Video Library API
scientific_limitations: Planet globes are schematic procedural educational visualizations, not precision DEM terrain models.
LOLA/MOLA DEM files are linked but not bundled; some files are multi-gigabyte.
Mission facts are summaries and should be verified against linked primary sources for formal publication.
